One oversized hinged folding magnifier, clearly handheld, and a palm-sized generic scrap fitting resting in other palm. Leaning slightly to weigh rather than smiling at viewer. No resemblance to Taffy or the gray alien boss.

jobs.name: The Quiet Stallholder

jobs.setup: Needs enough sales to pay tomorrow's rent; dislikes the water broker's cut.
jobs.quirk: Keeps straightening a single item customers never buy.
jobs.role: Notices the children arrive together, then separately; can choose to continue a sale rather than inform the broker. A small decision with moral weight.

Simple sun-faded clay-pink crossed shoulder garment over a plain charcoal skirted work layer and ordinary worn footwear; muted woven sleeve cuffs, not the boy's plum costume or repeated cheek marks. Small shallow wooden trading stand with folding side wings, one partly folded, supported on visible spindly legs so the person's lower legs and feet remain visible. A few ceramic clasps and repair fittings arranged sparsely; one hand straightens a single unsold clasp while gaze watches off-frame. One coherent single-character illustration, no full market backdrop.

Holds a FLAT rectangular inspection board under one arm; the other hand tests a simple detached latch fixture at waist height on a narrow stand. Matter-of-fact responsible expression, as if checking twice. No writing on board, no weapon or dangling keys that might be mistaken for the stolen key.

jobs.name: The Port Messenger

jobs.setup: Needs to reach cargo dispatch before its next transfer departs.
jobs.quirk: Always chooses their next doorway before finishing the current one.
jobs.role: Their purposeful exit toward the cargo ramp plants the onward route to the port. When the alert appears, a stopped step and turned head raise the stakes.

Plain layered travel shirt with asymmetrical dusty blue-gray outer tabard, cropped charcoal trousers that reveal long shins above flat reinforced walking shoes. ONE upright rigid dented delivery tube held close to body by a simple shoulder loop, broad capped ends, no lettering. Half-turned poised stance already choosing next doorway, economical and brisk rather than heroic. No duplicate of the boy's sack, belt, marks or outfit.
